sensory_details_i_remember: I remember the faint smell of antiseptic wafting through the clinic, mixed with the sweet scent of nervous sweat from the students
I noticed the flickering fluorescent lights above, casting an eerie glow on the anxious faces of the students
I felt the vibrations of murmured conversations and frantic typing on laptops, a palpable sense of tension in the air
I recall the sound of rustling papers and the occasional clinking of caffeine-stained mugs, a symphony of stress and anticipation
